title: Topic 3.8.2: Parable of the mustard seed

pages.lesson:
LESSON: PARABLE OF THE MUSTARD SEED

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.8.2: Parable of the mustard seed

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Parable of the mustard seed. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How does the parable of the mustard seed relate to the kingdom of God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. retell the parable of the mustard seed as guided by the Bible text
2. describe how the kingdom of God grows from a small beginning
3. explain how they contribute to the growth of the kingdom of God

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. retell the parable of the mustard seed as guided by the Bible text
   In simple words: practise until you can retell the parable of the mustard seed as guided by the Bible text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. describe how the kingdom of God grows from a small beginning
   In simple words: practise until you can describe how the kingdom of God grows from a small beginning. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. explain how they contribute to the growth of the kingdom of God
   In simple words: practise until you can explain how they contribute to the growth of the kingdom of God. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Parable of the mustard seed using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Parable of the mustard seed in the examples.
2. Explain Parable of the mustard seed to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Parable of the mustard seed.
4. Show that you can: retell the parable of the mustard seed as guided by the Bible text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Parable of the mustard seed using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Parable of the mustard seed important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Luke 13:18-19 and narrate the parable,
2. Draw a big tree with birds resting on its branches and compare it to the growth of God’s kingdom,
3. Role-play the activities they do in Church,
4. Creativity and Imagination: the skill of communicating new ideas is enhanced as learners draw a big tree and compare it to the growth of God’s kingdom.
5. Unity: is enhanced as learners work in groups to collect small seeds from the school compound.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. retell the parable of the mustard seed as guided by the Bible text
2. describe how the kingdom of God grows from a small beginning
3. explain how they contribute to the growth of the kingdom of God

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
